title: Coulthart: Republican presidents briefed, Democrats not

tellings.quote: Ross Coulthart recently came out and talked about how there sometimes seems to be a contrast between Republican presidents getting information and Democrat presidents not.

plain: Republican presidents of the United States sometimes seem to be told about UFO secrets while Democratic presidents are not, according to the journalist Ross Coulthart. The researcher Jason Simosa passes this on second-hand, saying Coulthart recently pointed out the contrast. If true, it would mean that who learns the secret depends on party politics rather than on holding the office.
